title: Inheritance of Manasseh

questions.question: Who was Machir?
options: The firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead
questions.correctAnswer: The firstborn of Manasseh and father of Gilead
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:1 (ESV): "...Machir the firstborn of Manasseh, the father of Gilead..."

questions.question: What kind of man was Machir?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:1 (ESV): "...because he was a man of war, therefore he had Gilead and Bashan."

questions.question: Who were the daughters of Zelophehad to ask for an inheritance?
options: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah
questions.correctAnswer: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:3 (ESV): "...Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah."

questions.question: What compliant did the people of Joseph bring to Joshua?
options: Why have you given me but one lot... seeing I am a numerous people?
questions.correctAnswer: Why have you given me but one lot... seeing I am a numerous people?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:14 (ESV): "...Why have you given me but one lot and one portion as an inheritance, although I am a numerous people...?"

questions.question: What did Joshua tell the people of Joseph to do if the hill country was too narrow?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:15 (ESV): "...go up to the forest, and there clear ground for yourselves..."

questions.question: Why did Zelophehad have no sons?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:3 (ESV): "Now Zelophehad... had no sons, but only daughters..."

questions.question: Who commanded that the daughters of Zelophehad be given an inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:4 (ESV): "...The Lord commanded Moses to give us an inheritance along with our brothers..."

questions.question: How many portions fell to Manasseh (west)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:5 (ESV): "Thus there fell to Manasseh ten portions, besides the land of Gilead..."

questions.question: Why could the people of Manasseh not take possession of those cities?
options: The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land
questions.correctAnswer: The Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:12 (ESV): "Yet the people of Manasseh could not take possession of those cities, but the Canaanites persisted in dwelling in that land."

questions.question: What advantage did the Canaanites have that Manasseh complained about?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:16 (ESV): "...all the Canaanites who live in the plain have chariots of iron..."

questions.question: Which cities within Issachar and Asher were given to Manasseh?
options: Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo
questions.correctAnswer: Beth-shean, Ibleam, Dor, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:11 (ESV): "Also in Issachar and in Asher Manasseh had Beth-shean... Ibleam... Dor... Endor... Taanach... Megiddo..."

questions.question: The region of the Perizzites and the Rephaim (giants) is mentioned as a place to do what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:15 (ESV): "...in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim."

questions.question: Did Manasseh drive out the Canaanites when they became strong?
options: They put them to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out
questions.correctAnswer: They put them to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:13 (ESV): "Now when the people of Israel grew strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, but did not utterly drive them out."

questions.question: On which side of the brook Kanah were the cities of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:9 (ESV): "...The cities here, to the south of the brook, were among the cities of Manasseh belong to Ephraim."

questions.question: What reassurance did Joshua give regarding the iron chariots?
options: "Though they have chariots of iron and though they are strong, you shall drive them out"
questions.correctAnswer: "Though they have chariots of iron and though they are strong, you shall drive them out"
questions.explanation: Joshua 17:18 (ESV): "...for you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong."

key_verse_text: ...but the hill country shall be yours, for though it is a forest, you shall clear it and possess it to its farthest borders. For you shall drive out the Canaanites, though they have chariots of iron, and though they are strong. (ESV)
